description: Your complete guide to online education in India. Search and compare 125+ UGC-DEB approved online universities. Get verified fees, NAAC accreditation grades, NIRF rankings, and programme details for MBA, BBA, MCA, and BCA courses. Check if any university is genuinely approved by UGC-DEB. Compare universities side by side on fees, rankings, and specialisations. All information is verified from official sources and updated regularly. edifyedu.in is India's independent, commission-free online education platform with no paid rankings.
